_comment: Manifeste d'ESSAI de direction artistique — Grèce antique + aquarelle. Sorties isolées dans assets/style-tests/, sans toucher aux tuiles de production. Usage: node scripts/generate-assets.mjs --manifest assets/style-tests.json --yes

style.greek_watercolor: hand-painted watercolor illustration on cold-pressed paper, visible paper grain and soft pigment blooms, translucent layered washes with gentle uneven edges, ancient Greek Mediterranean setting, warm Aegean daylight, natural earthy palette of olive green, terracotta, pale limestone and sun-bleached ochre, top-down orthographic view, no cast shadows, calm uniform composition with no focal point in the center, edges visually quiet and continuous, full-bleed square composition filling the entire canvas, no text, no borders, no frame, no vignette
style.minoan_fresco: hand-painted watercolor in the spirit of an ancient Minoan fresco, matte pigment washes on lime plaster, subtly aged and patinated surface with very fine crackle, flat decorative rendering with simplified organic shapes, Aegean palette of saffron yellow, terracotta red, deep sea blue, olive green and ivory, top-down orthographic view, no cast shadows, calm uniform composition with no focal point in the center, edges visually quiet and continuous, full-bleed square composition filling the entire canvas, no text, no borders, no frame, no vignette
style.flat_greek: clean flat vector illustration, crisp geometric shapes, flat solid tints with no texture and no painterly brushwork, elegant minimal stylisation, ancient Greek Mediterranean subject, refined antique palette, top-down orthographic view, no cast shadows, motifs evenly distributed across the whole surface, calm composition with no focal point in the center, edges quiet and continuous, the artwork bleeds fully beyond all four edges of the square
style.greek_mosaic: ancient Greek stone mosaic made of large regular square tesserae laid in an orderly grid, thin pale grout lines between tesserae, subtle tone variation from one tessera to the next, motif simplified enough to read clearly at small size, refined antique palette, top-down orthographic view, no cast shadows, evenly distributed across the whole surface, calm composition with no focal point in the center, the mosaic bleeds fully beyond all four edges of the square
style.greek_3d: stylised 3D rendered board game asset, smooth clean materials with a soft matte finish, gentle global illumination and subtle ambient occlusion, shallow relief seen from directly above in strict orthographic projection with no perspective distortion, the polished look of a modern digital board game, ancient Greek Aegean setting, refined natural palette, low visual noise, motifs evenly distributed across the whole surface, calm composition with no focal point in the center, edges quiet and continuous, the render fills and bleeds fully beyond all four edges of the square
